goal: Schritt 1: automatisierbare Keyboard-/Accessibility-Evidence für den Feld-Create-Flow bei 100/150/200 Prozent Layoutbelastung erzeugen | Schritt 2: nur konkret nachgewiesene Fokus-/Lesbarkeitsprobleme beheben und erneut gezielt prüfen; bei grünem Evidence-Lauf kein Produktfix

guide_delta.summary: Die Feldanlage wird automatisch mit normaler, großer und sehr großer Layoutbelastung sowie vollständig per Tastatur geprüft. Nur tatsächlich nachgewiesene Probleme dürfen anschließend geändert werden.

tests_required: Schritt 1: keyboard-only field-create flow at 160x40, 107x27 and 80x20
Schritt 1: field-type selector keeps focus and at least three visible rows at every scale proxy
Schritt 1: exactly seven field types remain present
Schritt 1: successful create performs exactly one write and ends on field-list focus
Schritt 1: emit SVG evidence for all three scale proxies plus JSON evidence summary
Zwischen-Gate: no focus/layout assertion may fail before step 2
Schritt 2: if evidence is green, record no product fix required; if red, patch only the concrete proven issue and rerun this test
Manifest V2 and strict scope validation
tests_explicitly_not_run: manual human perception acceptance because automated evidence cannot prove subjective readability
browser tests because CP-07T is a Textual TUI
full product suite because only field-create accessibility evidence is in scope
database/domain/repository regressions because frozen core is untouched
risks: terminal-grid reduction is an automated zoom/layout proxy, not a substitute for human visual perception testing
a too-small selector at 200 percent proxy may reveal a real focus/readability defect requiring a narrowly scoped step-2 fix
no layout or style change is permitted unless step-1 evidence fails
non_changes: no runtime product change in step 1
expected_side_effects: CI produces runtime/iteration-61 SVG and JSON evidence artifacts
step 2 is either a targeted evidence-driven fix or an explicit no-fix-needed completion
